intentions.title: Run a self-managed hosting fleet on Barkpark Cloud: build off-box, deploy on-box, scale to zero, back up, and self-report health without human hands on the boxes
intentions.evidence: internal/builder/builder.go claims queued Deployments and runs nixpacks on a dedicated build host so a Next.js build never starves the serving box; internal/runtime/runtime.go is the on-box Executor that loads the image, blue/green swaps containers, health-checks, renders Caddyfile, and flips the Site live; internal/waker/waker.go stops idle containers after DefaultIdleTimeout and wakes them on request so thousands of low-traffic sites cost ~5MB resident instead of container memory; internal/agent/agent.go+report.go is the on-box agent that phones home health/vitals/backup status and runs an approved 6-command allowlist; internal/backup/backup.go streams pg_dump through gzip into S3-compatible storage with a manifest for restore integrity.

intentions.title: Gate TLS certificate issuance and reverse-proxy routing through the control plane's ask-gate so a box is never a cert-issuance DoS target
intentions.evidence: internal/caddyfile/caddyfile.go: on_demand_tls consults GET /v1/tls/ask?domain=... before Caddy issues a cert for any hostname; 404 stops issuance for unregistered domains; MaintenanceHandler serves a branded 503 (not raw 502) only on Caddy-raised dial/timeout errors, never masking a real app 4xx/5xx.

intentions.title: Land a fresh Barkpark instance in a working, content-populated state (workspace + schemas + seed data + read token + webhook) instead of an empty box
intentions.evidence: internal/bootstrap/bootstrap.go executes six idempotent steps (workspace, schemas, seed+publish, read-token mint-once, webhook upsert with STORE-ONCE secret, env resolution) against a scoped /w/<ws>/p/default/v1/... URL per a declarative internal/template manifest; called by the provisioner chain after the health gate succeeds.

intentions.title: Keep every Barkpark surface (CLI table, dashboard dot, task board card) agreeing on what a status color means, with unknown tokens rendering neutral rather than guessed
intentions.evidence: internal/semrole/semrole.go: single For(status) mapping to ok/info/warn/danger/'' shared by cloud/deploy/health tokens and task-lifecycle tokens (disjoint vocabularies, TestVocabulariesDisjoint enforced); TaskLifecycles() exported so internal/taskboard's RoleFor is parity-tested against this table in CI; chrome_gen.go/tokens_gen.go are generated companions keeping the color tokens in sync.

intentions.title: Give the CLI a hermetically-testable seam into every cloud-control-plane operation a user can drive (login, fleet list, provider connect, launch, go-live) without duplicating apiclient's code or coupling to it
intentions.evidence: internal/cloudclient/client.go: framework-free HTTP client scoped to the user's whole fleet (distinct from apiclient's per-content-server scope), deliberately shares no code/types with apiclient so the two can drift independently, YAGNI-scoped to exactly the 25 methods `bp` Cloud commands need (no retries/pagination/websocket).

intentions.title: Make every build/deploy/backup/agent component swappable behind interfaces so the full lifecycle (claim to build to push to run to health-check to backup to report) runs hermetically in tests with no live Docker, Postgres, or control plane
intentions.evidence: builder.Builder injects HTTPClient/Runner/Filesystem; runtime.Executor injects HTTPClient/Runner/FS/PortAllocator; backup.Backup depends on DumpSource/ObjStore interfaces, not real pg_dump/S3; waker.ContainerManager and Now() are both injectable/fake-able in tests; agent.CommandRunner is injected with ExecRunner as the only production implementation.
